positive_snippets: We stayed for 4 nights from 3 to 7 Dec 2025, along with our guests. It's a beautiful property, with a great location, excellent team in the staff like Rajiv in the front office, Disha in Sales. The rooms are very comfortable with good amenities, food was excellent. Staff in housekeeping, kitchen, dining room and even the security guard and bell boys had wonderful and positive attitude, rendering great service and hospitality. Would whole heartedly recommend this property at Sundar Nagar, New Delhi.

We had a wonderful time at Ahuja Residency. The hospitality is excellent. Cleanliness is par excellence and breakfast is very good. It is very convenient for all local travel. Close to most of the sightseeing.
Very good property. Good for family and long stay. Good staff, Neat rooms, Good service & food. Best option found in Delhi after many searches.
